verdict.rationale: Weave's own evaluation framework is documented as a way to compare changes over time and identify regressions. The marketing site claims 'evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions,' and leaderboards can aggregate evaluations. But the evidence has no detailed first-party documentation of a side-by-side eval-run comparison view that diffs prompt or model versions. missing for 10: documented side-by-side comparison UI/workflow for eval runs, per-example diffing between prompt/model versions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: Weave provides powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions before they reach users
measure your LLM application’s performance against repeatable test cases, compare changes over time, and identify regressions
Build rigorous, apples-to-apples evaluations for language model use cases
Aggregate evaluations into leaderboards featuring the best performers and share them across your organization.
